name: Little Wolf River
gaugeName: LITTLE WOLF RIVER AT ROYALTON, WI
blurb: Upper Little Wolf trips from Wolf River Road through County J to the takeout above Big Falls, plus separately reviewed downstream access areas near Manawa and Royalton.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.

sections.notes: County guide trip with Class II rapids. Suitable for paddlers with moving-water experience. Access-area markers and the dotted river overview do not identify an exact landing approach.

sections.notes: The county guide flags the Dells and finishes this trip at Big Falls above the dam. Check conditions, scout the takeout before launching and do not continue over the dam or falls.

notices.title: Take out above Big Falls Dam
notices.text: Finish at the pond-side ramp before the dam. The downstream falls are outside this trip; no portage or continuous passage through them has been reviewed.
notices.sourceName: Village of Big Falls — parks; Waupaca County paddling map

sections.notes: Markers identify agency-listed access; the map states whether a landing or an approximate facility area has been reviewed. Mileage is preliminary, measured along USGS river geometry; it is not a surveyed paddling route. Difficulty has not been independently rated for every section. Check current conditions, hazards and access with the managing agency before paddling.
sections.accessReview: Big Falls Pond Boat Ramp is above Big Falls Dam. A legal, usable route past the dam and falls is not established. The former Manawa millpond endpoint also needs a current landing review after the 2024 breach.
sections.routeReview: Do not plan this as a continuous float: Big Falls Dam separates the pond-side ramp from the downstream river, and the Manawa millpond was lost in 2024.

notices.title: Manawa millpond changed after the 2024 breach
notices.text: The City of Manawa’s July 2026 update describes continuing dam and millpond restoration planning. Older pond access and trip descriptions need a fresh review before use.
notices.sourceName: City of Manawa — dam restoration updates

sections.accessReview: The Manawa levee breach in July 2024 emptied the millpond. The city was still planning restoration in July 2026; present-day landing usability and passage through the dam site remain unresolved.
sections.routeReview: Current access and passage through the Manawa dam site need review after the 2024 breach. No continuous float route is approved.
